data.summary: ExampleLend reads a Pyth oracle price with no staleness or confidence check
data.description: The liquidation handler in ExampleLend calls get_price_unchecked on a Pyth price account and uses the returned value directly to value collateral. With no staleness (publish-slot age) check and no confidence-interval guard, an attacker can manipulate the oracle-reported price within a single transaction and liquidate positions at a mispriced value, draining the lending pool.
